newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Yugoslav president in Zimbabwe for state visit.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav president in Zimbabwe for state visit.

text.p: Yugoslav President Zoran Lilic arrived in Harare on Wednesday on the first leg of a tour of Africa to promote trade.
He was to meet President Robert Mugabe for talks later in the day.

Zimbabwean officials said the two countries would conclude agreements to promote investment and establish air services between Harare and Belgrade. Lilic leaves on Saturday for Tanzania, Ghana and Guinea.
